name: Henan Zhongfu Industrial Co.,Ltd
summary: Henan Zhongfu Industrial Co.,Ltd processes, manufactures, and sells electrolytic aluminum and aluminum products in China. The company offers carbon series products; industrial investment, investment management, enterprise management consulting, and coal mine investment services; and new product and new material technology research, achievement transfer, process design, and related technical consulting services. It also provides can sheets, food cans, new energy batteries and packaging aluminum foil, alloy sheet, anodizing material, and aluminum alloy cast wheel hub.
